short_description:
Got GTA 6's Vintage Vice City Pack? Your '55 Vapid Stanier and its garage wait outside the Ocean View Hotel in Vice Beach. A task appears in the map index under Exploration (guides place it in Chapter 3). The pack came with digital purchases before November 20 and boxed copies while stocks last. No story spoilers. Every spot: vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

📍 Map Spot #20 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: PC Gamer, GTABase, Gfinity.
